source: The Agriculture Magazine (ទស្សនាវដ្តីកសិកម្ម), Issue 247, Quarter 3, 2013, poster page 'បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះ ពោត (២)' (Cultivation Technique: Corn, Part 2) — insect pests and diseases section; credited to TSTD-TA 735-CAM project
text:
This poster page is a photo-identification chart of insect pests and diseases affecting corn (សត្វល្អិតចង្រៃ និងជំងឺ), with each photo captioned by name only (no separate descriptive text or control recommendations are given on this page).

Pests shown: ដង្គ្វាកាត់ស្លឹក (leaf-cutting caterpillar/cutworm, shown with its adult moth stage labeled 'Adult'); ដង្គ្វាស៊ីរងដើម (stem-boring caterpillar); ដង្កូវជៅពោត (corn borer larva, shown boring into a corn ear, with its adult moth labeled 'មេអំពៅដង្កូវជៅពោត'); ស្រិងខ្យង (snail damage).

Diseases shown: ជំងឺលីហ្គាយ (a leaf spot/blight type disease); ជំងឺលឿងស្លឹក (leaf yellowing disease); ជំងឺច្រេះ (rust disease, shown as orange pustules on a leaf); ជំងឺរលួយដើម (stem rot disease, shown as rot at the stem base); ជំងឺរណាកស្រទាប់ស្លឹក (leaf sheath rot/disease); ជំងឺស្មាត់ (corn smut, shown as characteristic pale gray/white fungal galls replacing kernels on the ear).

The bottom of the page carries a second section header 'ការថែទាំ និងប្រមូលផល' (Care and Harvest) illustrated only with photos of farmers in corn fields and holding harvested ears — no accompanying body text is present on this page, so no care or harvest procedure details could be extracted from it.
